name: Gabon
description: Gabon from the Bantu peoples and the slave coast to French rule, Albert Schweitzer, independence in 1960, the Bongo family and its forests.

checkpoints.name: French Gabon
checkpoints.note: France made treaties on the coast from 1839 and founded Libreville in 1849. Schweitzer opened his hospital in 1913.

checkpoints.name: The Bongo years
checkpoints.note: Gabon became independent in 1960. Oil made it rich, and the Bongo family ruled for more than half a century.

checkpoints.name: After the coup
checkpoints.note: The army ended the Bongo rule in 2023, and its leader was elected president in 2025.
